text:
I do not know where they come from,

your laughter, your joy,

in what instant you learned

to look face to face

at everything we fear.

To look it in the eyes

as if there were nothing

to fear

and your gaze

had discovered

among so much disorder

a principle of light.


As if you were

at the edge of mystery

and nothing surprised

your faith

and you spoke to us

not of what you are seeing,

but of what you feel

coming

and understand so easily...


Thus then you separate

from terror its daily

wrapping

and your hand

traces in the darkness

a safe path.

translation.title: I Do Not Know Where They Come From...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the speaker's wonder at a gaze that extracts light from disorder.
